subject_definitions
<Subject 1> is the woman in <Picture 1>: a pale-skinned young woman with extremely long white hair, soft straight bangs, and a half-up bun decorated with red ornaments. She wears an elegant fantasy-style outfit in white, black, and deep red, including an off-shoulder white top, translucent flowing sleeves, layered skirt armor details, metallic accessories, and black high-heeled boots. Preserve her identity, hairstyle, red ornaments, white-black-red costume palette, translucent sleeves, layered skirt structure, and long flowing hair throughout the video.

summary
A 10-second elegant solo dance video shows <Subject 1> performing a clearly choreographed classical Chinese dance on an ancient ceremonial platform under a cloudy sky. Her motion should feel graceful, lively, and continuous, with distinct steps, turns, sleeve gestures, and a final poised ending. The choreography should be expressive and beautiful rather than random.

detailed_description
The entire video focuses on <Subject 1> alone. She performs a refined classical Chinese dance with light traveling steps, controlled turns, one diagonal leap, flowing sleeve gestures, and one elegant spin. Her upper body remains graceful and upright, while her footwork is light and precise. Her extremely long white hair, translucent sleeves, and layered skirt respond naturally to each movement. Keep her face recognizable and stable throughout. Avoid random dancing, modern freestyle motion, exaggerated hip-hop gestures, or chaotic movement.

scene
An ancient ceremonial platform under a cloudy sky. The ground is decorated with faint glowing patterns. A few light petals drift gently in the wind. The background remains elegant, airy, and stable, without distracting extra elements.

[Shot 1: 00:00-00:02.000]
A wide-to-medium full-body shot establishes the ritual platform. <Subject 1> stands slightly off-center in a poised classical Chinese dance stance: one foot grounded, the other stepping lightly forward, one arm curved above her head, and the other extended diagonally outward. Her long white hair and translucent sleeves are lifted gently by the wind. The camera makes a subtle forward push-in.

[Shot 2: 00:02.000-00:04.500]
The camera transitions into a medium full-body tracking shot. <Subject 1> accelerates into two light traveling dance steps, then performs a smooth pivot and a controlled half-turn. Her skirt swings outward in a soft circular sweep, and her translucent sleeves trail behind her arms. Her posture stays elegant and upright, with precise footwork and graceful control.

[Shot 3: 00:04.500-00:07.000]
In a fluid continuation, <Subject 1> performs a quick diagonal leap across the platform, landing softly and immediately flowing into a low turning step. Her arms open outward like unfolding ribbons, then cross briefly in front of her torso before extending outward again. Her hair, sleeves, and skirt move dynamically but remain clean and readable.

[Shot 4: 00:07.000-00:09.000]
The camera arcs around <Subject 1> in a smooth semicircle. She executes one elegant fast spin with one leg extended low, while her skirt flares into a broad crescent shape. Her head follows the turn with a slight delayed follow-through, creating a graceful finishing dynamic. Her long hair and sleeves fan outward naturally.

[Shot 5: 00:09.000-00:10.000]
The dance resolves into a final classical pose. <Subject 1> finishes facing slightly toward the camera, one arm extended upward and the other curved near her waist, with one foot pointed lightly behind her. Her hair and sleeves continue to settle gently after the final turn. The camera ends on a medium full-body to medium shot with a subtle push-in, emphasizing both her expression and the completed pose.

camera
Use smooth cinematic camera movement with clear shot progression. Maintain readable framing so the choreography is visible. Avoid chaotic camera shake. Let the camera gently push in, track, and arc around the dancer in a fluid way.

style
cinematic fantasy classical Chinese dance, elegant choreography, graceful sleeve movement, flowing long hair, refined costume motion, stable identity, minimal flicker, soft dramatic lighting, temporally coherent, beautiful and readable movement

constraints
preserve stable face identity, preserve the same hairstyle and costume details, keep the dance clearly choreographed, no extra characters, no random motion, no facial distortion, no extra limbs, no hand distortion, no abrupt cuts, no excessive speed, no chaotic background motion
